items.description:
Libra Pharmacy is an independent dispensing pharmacy rather than a branch of one of the big retail chains, which lets it focus on personal service at the counter alongside the usual pharmacy ranges. Along with prescription dispensing and medicine advice, the shelves carry skincare, first aid supplies, footcare products and baby-care essentials, covering most of what a household needs for everyday health without a trip across town.

The pharmacy trades from Landdros Mare Street in Polokwane Central, within easy reach of the surrounding offices, shops and residential streets that make up the city centre. For residents and workers in the area, it offers a convenient stop for repeat medication, over-the-counter remedies and small health purchases on the way to or from other errands in Polokwane, Limpopo.

Game Mall of the North is one of the anchor stores at Mall of the North, the roughly 78,000 square-metre super-regional shopping centre that ranks as Limpopo's premier retail and leisure destination. As a discount department store, it carries a broad spread of merchandise, from electronics and sporting goods to home, garden, beauty and general household products, under the pricing-led format the Game chain is known for nationally.

Sitting at the corner of the R81 and N1 bypass in Bendor, the mall drew more than 8.1 million shopper visits in 2025 alone, pulling in buyers from across Limpopo as well as visitors from neighbouring Botswana and Zimbabwe. Alongside fellow anchors Woolworths, Pick n Pay, Checkers and Edgars, Game gives shoppers at this busy Polokwane hub a one-stop option for bulk and everyday purchases.

Spitz Mall of the North is a footwear, clothing and accessories store trading under the long-established Spitz name, a retailer recognised across South Africa for stocking a wide range of branded shoes alongside bags and accessories for men, women and children. Shoppers can expect the sizing range and seasonal lines typical of a national footwear specialist, with styles spanning formal, casual and sport.

This branch operates from Shop U80A inside Mall of the North in Bendor, placing it among the mall's cluster of fashion and footwear outlets. For added convenience, the store offers click-and-collect and pay-on-collection ordering, letting shoppers in Polokwane reserve stock online and pick it up in person rather than waiting on delivery, a useful option for anyone shopping on a schedule in Limpopo's busiest retail centre.

Dis-Chem Platinum Park is a branch of one of South Africa's largest pharmacy and health retail groups, known nationally for combining a dispensary with wide-ranging beauty, baby, vitamin and personal-care departments under one roof. Shoppers typically find everything from prescription medicine and chronic care support to skincare, haircare and wellness products, with trained pharmacy staff on hand for advice.

The store trades from Platinum Park Shopping Centre on Watermelon Street in Bendor Park, giving the surrounding Polokwane suburbs a full-service health and beauty option close to home. Because it carries both dispensary services and retail stock, it suits anyone combining a prescription collection with an everyday shop, rather than visiting separate stores across Bendor Park for each.

PostNet Flora Park is part of the long-running South African franchise built around printing, courier and small-business support services, with branches in shopping centres across the country. Typical services at a PostNet store include document copying and printing, binding, domestic and international courier dispatch, stationery sales and private mailbox rental for people and businesses without a fixed postal address.

This outlet operates from the Spar Shopping Centre on Marshall Street in Flora Park, putting it within reach of homes, offices and small businesses across that part of Polokwane. For local residents, it offers a single stop for sending parcels, printing documents or picking up stationery, saving a separate trip into the city centre for routine courier and office tasks.

Sterpark Guesthouse offers overnight accommodation with round-the-clock reception, meaning guests arriving late from the road or an early flight are never left waiting at the door. Rooms come air-conditioned and fitted with television, and staff can arrange airport transfers for guests who would rather not organise their own transport into Polokwane.

A buffet breakfast is included, and the guesthouse runs its own on-site restaurant serving South African and local dishes, so visitors can eat without leaving the property after a long day. Set on Gemini Street in Sterpark, the guesthouse suits business travellers and tourists alike who want a quiet residential base within easy reach of central Polokwane, Limpopo, without sacrificing the comforts of a full-service stay.

CrossFit Firebox is an officially affiliated CrossFit gym, meaning its coaching follows the programming and standards set by the global CrossFit brand rather than a generic gym template. Classes are coached in groups, with sessions running in both 30- and 60-minute formats so members can fit training around work or family commitments, and an extra class is added every second Saturday for those wanting more volume.

Workouts are scaled to suit different fitness levels, from newcomers building basic movement patterns to experienced athletes chasing competitive times, so nobody is left doing a workout beyond their current ability. The gym trains members from its base on Diemeer Street in Welgelegen, giving this part of Polokwane a dedicated functional-fitness community rather than just a room full of equipment.

Hi-Q Ladanna is a fitment centre operating under the Hi-Q banner, a well-known name in South African autocare built around tyres, batteries and the mechanical work that keeps a vehicle roadworthy. The branch fits and sells tyres, supplies batteries, and handles suspension and brake work alongside general mechanical servicing and rim repairs, covering most of what a car needs outside of a dealership service plan.

Positioned at the corner of Witklip Street and Pietersburg Road in Ladanna, it serves drivers from across that side of Polokwane who need routine maintenance done without booking in at a dealer. Being part of a national chain also means parts and tyre brands are typically kept in stock, cutting down on waiting time for Limpopo motorists.

Foodzone Ladanna is a neighbourhood supermarket stocking the everyday grocery range a household relies on week to week, from fresh produce and pantry staples to household basics, without requiring a drive to one of the larger mall-based chains. Alongside the grocery aisles, the store runs a takeaway food counter, giving shoppers a hot-meal option on the same visit.

That takeaway menu is also available for delivery, which suits residents in Ladanna who would rather order in than cook or queue. Trading from Pietersburg Street, the store serves as a convenient, close-to-home option for this part of Polokwane, combining grocery shopping and a quick meal under one roof rather than splitting the errand between two stops in Limpopo.

RSC Polokwane, trading as Reinforcing Steel Contractors, supplies and fabricates the reinforcing steel used in concrete construction, a specialised line of the building trade that most general hardware stores do not stock. Builders and contractors working on anything from foundations to structural slabs typically need steel cut and bent to specification, which is the core of what a reinforcing steel supplier like this one provides.

The branch operates from Kobalt Street in Superbia, placing it within Polokwane's industrial cluster alongside other building-material suppliers. For contractors working on sites across Limpopo, having a local fabricator cuts down on the lead time and transport cost of sourcing structural steel from further afield, making it a practical supplier for projects of varying size.

This general practice in Annadale offers the everyday consultations most households need from a local doctor, alongside more specific services such as chronic disease management for conditions like hypertension and diabetes. Patients can also book women's health checks and occupational health assessments, the kind of workplace-related medical sign-off that many employers in the area require.

Diabetes and HIV management programmes run alongside these general services, giving patients with ongoing conditions a single point of continuity rather than being referred elsewhere for routine monitoring. Based on Doornkraal Street in Annadale, the practice serves as an accessible local option for residents of this part of Polokwane who want general and chronic care handled by the same GP rather than juggling multiple providers across Limpopo.

Eduan Park Cafe & Bakery is a neighbourhood bakery and cafe rather than a large chain outlet, with fresh baked goods made for the local community alongside light meals for anyone wanting something quick to eat. The kind of stock typically found at a bakery like this includes bread, pastries and baked treats, paired with a small range of everyday convenience items for last-minute household needs.

Trading from Harvey Street in Eduan Park, the cafe serves as a casual local stop for residents picking up breakfast, a light lunch or bread for the evening meal without travelling further into Polokwane. Its convenience-store side also covers the odd grocery item residents might otherwise have to drive into town for, in this corner of Limpopo.

The Crazy Store Thornhill belongs to the national discount variety chain long known across South Africa for stretching a small budget across household goods, stationery, toys, decor and seasonal items. The format relies on frequent stock turnover and low pricing, so shelves tend to change often, which keeps regular shoppers coming back to see what is new.

This branch trades from Shop 31 inside Thornhill Shopping Centre on Munnik Avenue, giving residents of Thornhill Estate and the surrounding Polokwane suburbs a nearby option for everyday essentials and small gift items without a trip to a larger mall. It suits shoppers looking for a quick, affordable stop for odds and ends rather than a full specialised retail visit in this part of Limpopo.

Freelance Photo Centre is an independent photography and printing shop offering digital printing from a range of formats, so customers are not limited to a single file type or camera source. Beyond standard prints, the shop handles photo enlargements for anyone wanting a bigger statement piece from a favourite image.

Custom picture framing, box framing and frame repairs round out the service, which suits customers finishing off artwork, certificates or family photos rather than leaving them in a drawer. Operating from Shop 9 in Palm Centre on Grobler Street in Moregloed, the business gives this part of Polokwane a dedicated photo and framing specialist, a category not always well covered by the bigger retail chains found elsewhere in Limpopo.

Palm Health Medi Centre is a general practice that has been operating in Moregloed since 2013, offering the standard range of GP consultations for everyday illness, check-ups and referrals that most patients need from a local doctor. Over more than a decade in the same location, the practice has built up the kind of routine patient base a neighbourhood GP typically relies on.

Beyond general consultations, the centre also provides antenatal care and ultrasound scanning, giving expecting mothers in the area a nearby option for pregnancy monitoring without being referred to a separate clinic. Based at the corner of Grobler and Biccard Street in Moregloed, it serves patients across this part of Polokwane, Limpopo, looking for both everyday and maternity-related medical care.

Simply Pizza Cycad Centre is a pizza restaurant built around a wide, affordably priced range of cheese pizzas, the kind of straightforward menu that keeps regulars ordering without needing to study a long list of options. It is the sort of casual eatery families and groups turn to when nobody wants the hassle of cooking.

The restaurant offers dine-in seating as well as delivery and pickup, covering most of the ways customers in Bendor Park like to order a quick meal. Trading from Shop 9 in Cycad Centre, at the corner of Outspan Drive and General Maritz Street, it gives this part of Polokwane a dependable, no-fuss pizza option close to home, rather than requiring a trip further into Limpopo's city centre.

Floramed Mediese Sentrum houses several general practitioners under one roof, alongside a physiotherapist and a clinical psychologist, giving patients access to more than one discipline without being referred across town. That mix is particularly useful for anyone dealing with an injury needing both medical and physio follow-up, or mental health support alongside general care.

The centre is contracted to most medical aids, while also accepting cash-paying patients, which keeps it accessible to a broad range of households in the area. Based on Mc Donald Street in Flora Park, it serves as a multi-disciplinary medical option for residents of this Polokwane suburb who would otherwise need to visit several separate practices across Limpopo to cover the same ground.

Laerskool Ivy Park is a Section 21 public primary school, meaning it is state-funded but governed with a degree of financial independence by its own school governing body. It falls under the Quintile 5 classification, the highest funding band in South Africa's school system, which generally reflects a well-resourced surrounding community.

Annual school fees at this classification typically run from roughly R24,000 to R36,000, a figure in keeping with other Quintile 5 primary schools nationally. Based on Smuts Road in Ivy Park, the school serves families in this part of Polokwane seeking a public primary education with the facilities and fee structure associated with a top-quintile institution, rather than the no-fee model used elsewhere in Limpopo.

Getrz Flowers & Decor works as an event specialist rather than a simple flower counter, putting together floral arrangements and decor for occasions such as weddings, birthdays and corporate functions. That event focus means the business is set up to handle a full room or venue rather than just a single bouquet.

Alongside the floral and decor side, the team also coordinates event and party planning, covering logistics that go beyond flowers alone, such as layout and theme. Operating from Ben Harris Street in Westenburg, the business serves clients across Polokwane planning a function who want flowers, decor and planning handled together rather than coordinating separate suppliers for each part of the event in Limpopo.

Ladanna Wholesalers supplies soft drinks and water in bulk to local retailers, carrying recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Pepsi, Twizza and Red Bull rather than operating as a general grocery wholesaler. That beverage-only focus lets the business stock deep ranges of the brands it does carry, which smaller retailers often struggle to match on their own shelves.

Based on Witklip Street in Ladanna, the wholesaler serves shopkeepers and small retailers across this part of Polokwane who need to restock fridges and shelves without ordering directly from the beverage manufacturers themselves. For local traders in Limpopo, buying from a nearby wholesaler like this one also cuts down on delivery delays compared with larger regional distribution centres.

Alert Steel Polokwane is one of six Alert Steel retail outlets serving the greater Polokwane area, supplying steel and rebar products to builders, contractors and industrial customers. The business traces its roots back to 1997, which has given it decades to build relationships with the construction trade across the region.

Trading from the corner of Nikkel and Kobalt Street in Superbia, the branch sits within Polokwane's industrial precinct alongside other building-material suppliers, making it a convenient stop for contractors already sourcing materials in that part of town. Having multiple outlets across greater Polokwane also means stock availability tends to be more consistent than relying on a single steel supplier elsewhere in Limpopo.

Chicken Licken Seshego Plaza carries the name of one of South Africa's most recognisable fried chicken chains, known nationally for its spicy chicken recipes, burgers and value meal combinations aimed at quick, affordable eating. The menu is built for speed, suiting customers grabbing lunch on a break or a family ordering dinner on the way home.

This branch trades from Shop 36 in Seshego Plaza on New Era Drive, placing it among the other retail and food outlets at that centre. For residents of Seshego and the surrounding Polokwane area, it offers a familiar, consistent fast-food option without needing to travel into the city centre, matching the same menu and recipes found at Chicken Licken branches across Limpopo and the rest of the country.

Van Schaik Bookstore Turfloop Plaza is the Mankweng branch of a bookseller long associated with academic textbooks and study material in South Africa, alongside a general range of fiction, stationery and gift items. Its position near the University of Limpopo makes it a natural stop for students needing prescribed course material each semester.

Beyond textbooks, the store carries the broader stock typical of a Van Schaik branch, including everyday stationery and reading material for staff and residents in the area, not just students. Trading from Shop 4B in Turfloop Plaza on University Road, it serves the Mankweng community and the university population together, covering both academic and general bookshop needs in this part of Polokwane, Limpopo.

Mankweng Lodge offers guest rooms with private bathrooms and mountain views, a setting that suits visitors wanting a quieter base away from the busier parts of Polokwane. Free Wi-Fi and private parking are included, along with private check-in for guests arriving outside typical office hours.

Unlike some larger accommodation options, the lodge does not run an on-site restaurant or pool, keeping its offering focused on comfortable, private overnight stays rather than a full resort experience. Located near Paledi Mall in Mamadimo Park, Mankweng, it suits guests visiting the University of Limpopo area or travelling through this part of Polokwane who want straightforward, private lodging without paying for amenities they may not use.

Clicks Cycad Centre operates as both a pharmacy and a retail store under the Clicks banner, one of the most widely recognised health, beauty and homeware chains in South Africa. Shoppers can fill prescriptions at the pharmacy counter while also browsing cosmetics, personal-care products, baby items and small household goods on the same visit.

The branch trades from Shop 14 inside Cycad Centre on Outspan Drive in Bendor Ext 59, putting it alongside other retailers at that shopping centre. For residents of Bendor Park and nearby Polokwane suburbs, having both the dispensary and general retail side under one roof saves splitting errands between a separate pharmacy and a beauty or homeware store elsewhere in Limpopo.

Wonderland Pre-School & Foundation Phase is a Christian-based school covering nursery, pre-primary and foundation phase education, registered since 1980, giving it a long-standing presence in Sterpark's early-childhood education landscape. Around 103 learners are currently enrolled, supported by a staff of roughly 12 across the different age groups.

That combination of a faith-based approach and decades of operation has let the school build routines and facilities suited specifically to younger learners, from nursery age through to the foundation phase grades. Based on Munnik Avenue in Sterpark, it serves families across this part of Polokwane looking for an established, values-based option for their children's earliest years of schooling in Limpopo.

H.G. Bava CC is a family-run furniture business trading in Superbia since 1910, now operated by the fourth generation of the same family, which makes it one of the longer-standing furniture retailers in the Polokwane area. Both wholesale and retail customers are served, with lounge suites, bedroom sets and mattresses forming the core of the range.

Custom-made furniture is also available for customers wanting pieces built to a specific size or style rather than off-the-shelf stock. The business delivers free of charge across Limpopo and Gauteng, extending its reach well beyond its Nelson Mandela Drive premises in Superbia, Polokwane, making it a practical option for customers furnishing a home without arranging their own transport for bulky items.

Ladannah Hardware is known locally as the old Limpopo Store, a name that has stuck with residents even as the shop continues trading as a general hardware supplier in Annadale. It stocks the building materials and home-improvement supplies a typical household or small contractor needs for repairs, renovations and general maintenance work.

Being a one-stop hardware shop rather than a specialised supplier means customers can usually find tools, fittings and materials together in a single visit rather than driving between several stores. Trading from Witklip Street in Annadale, it serves the surrounding community in this part of Polokwane with the everyday hardware range that keeps home-improvement projects moving along without unnecessary delays.

Mukurumanzi Lodge is a 4-star bush lodge offering eight en-suite rooms set in a bushveld atmosphere just outside Polokwane, a different pace from the city-centre hotels nearer the CBD. A restaurant and sports bar operate on-site, giving guests somewhere to eat and unwind without leaving the property after a game drive or a day of travel.

A swimming pool and jacuzzi are available for guests wanting to relax, alongside free Wi-Fi and parking for those travelling by car. The lodge also runs an airport shuttle and laundry service, both useful for business travellers and tourists passing through. Located on Third Avenue in Dalmada, it gives visitors to Polokwane, Limpopo, a bush-style stay without being far from the city.

The Village Inn sits on a quiet smallholding in the bush along the Tzaneen road outside Polokwane, a setting that trades city convenience for a slower, more rural atmosphere. Family rooms come with private bathrooms and air-conditioning, suiting travellers wanting space rather than a single standard room.

A swimming pool is available for guests during warmer months, and the inn's own restaurant serves South African cuisine with both halal and vegetarian options on the menu, a detail that broadens who can comfortably eat on-site. Based on Third Street in Dalmada AH, the guesthouse suits travellers heading toward Tzaneen or passing through Polokwane who want a rural stopover rather than a city-centre hotel in Limpopo.

New Look Primary School is a no-fee public primary school, meaning tuition is state-funded and families are not charged school fees, a model used for schools serving lower-income communities. It falls under the Capricorn South Schools region and teaches the national CAPS curriculum across the primary grades.

The school currently enrols around 1,445 learners, taught by a staff of 38 educators, a sizeable school by primary-level standards in the area. Based in Extension 71, Polokwane, it serves as a key education access point for families in this part of the city who rely on no-fee public schooling, giving large numbers of children a structured CAPS-based education close to home.

Seshego Guesthouse offers bed and breakfast accommodation with en-suite rooms fitted with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen televisions and mini-fridges, covering the basics most travellers expect from a comfortable overnight stay. Breakfast is included in the stay, saving guests from having to find a meal elsewhere first thing in the morning.

Free parking is also provided, a practical detail for guests arriving by car rather than relying on taxis or shuttles. Located on Thutlwa Street in Zone 8, Seshego, the guesthouse gives visitors to this part of Polokwane a straightforward, well-equipped place to stay, whether passing through for business or visiting family in the area, without the cost of a larger hotel elsewhere in Limpopo.

Gym4U Seshego is a fitness centre forming part of the wider Gym4u network, which operates a number of gyms across Limpopo under the same brand. That network backing typically means a consistent equipment standard and training approach across branches, rather than a single independent gym operating on its own.

Trading from Shop 25 inside Seshego Plaza on New Era Drive, the gym gives residents of Seshego a nearby training option without needing to travel to one of the larger gyms elsewhere in Polokwane. For members who move between areas, belonging to a multi-branch network can also mean more flexibility than a single-site gym offers in this part of Limpopo.

Pick n Pay Liquor Cycad stocks the wine, spirits, beer and other beverages typical of a dedicated liquor outlet attached to the wider Pick n Pay retail group, one of South Africa's largest grocery chains. Being a standalone liquor store rather than a small in-aisle section means a wider range of labels and price points than a general supermarket liquor aisle usually carries.

The store trades inside Cycad Shopping Centre, at the corner of General Maritz and Outspan Drive in Bendor Park, alongside the centre's other retailers. For shoppers in this part of Polokwane doing a grocery run at the same centre, it offers the convenience of picking up drinks for an event or the week without a separate trip across town.

Pick n Pay Savannah Mall is a full-service supermarket branch of the national Pick n Pay chain, carrying groceries, fresh produce, meat, bakery items and household goods under one roof. As one of South Africa's largest grocery retailers, Pick n Pay is generally known for a broad private-label range alongside branded stock, giving shoppers choice across most price points.

The store trades inside Savannah Mall, at the corner of Grimm Street and Thabo Mbeki Street in Fauna Park, forming part of the mall's main grocery anchor. For households in this part of Polokwane, it serves as the primary weekly shopping stop at the centre, covering most everyday grocery needs without requiring a separate visit to a smaller store elsewhere in Limpopo.

RealNet Polokwane is the local franchise office of the RealNet property group, handling property sales across residential, commercial, industrial and agricultural categories rather than focusing on just one type of listing. That spread suits a region like Limpopo, where agricultural and smallholding property often sits alongside standard residential listings.

Beyond sales, the office also manages letting and property management for landlords who would rather not handle tenants directly, covering the ongoing side of property ownership as well as the initial sale. Based on General Viljoen Street in Welgelegen, the office serves buyers, sellers and landlords across Polokwane looking for a single agency able to handle a wide range of property types in one place.

The Pool Team Polokwane stocks swimming pool equipment and supplies, including pumps, chemicals and accessories from established brands such as Kreepy Krauly, Baracuda and Eartheco, covering most of what a pool owner needs to keep a pool running through the year. Carrying several recognised brands rather than a single house range gives customers options across different price points and pool types.

A complimentary water analysis service is also offered, letting pool owners bring in a sample to check chemical balance before buying treatment products, rather than guessing what to purchase. Trading from General Viljoen Street in Welgelegen, the store serves pool owners across Polokwane who need equipment, chemicals or advice on keeping a pool properly maintained in the Limpopo climate.

Netstar Polokwane is the local branch of Netstar, a long-established national vehicle tracking and recovery company offering real-time GPS tracking for cars, motorcycles, trucks and other vehicles. Fleet management services are also provided, giving business owners with multiple vehicles a way to monitor an entire fleet rather than tracking units one at a time.

Vehicle recovery support rounds out the offering, which matters most in the event of theft or hijacking, when a fast tracking response can be the difference in recovering a vehicle at all. Operating from Iran Avenue in Superbia, the branch serves vehicle owners and businesses across Polokwane and the wider Limpopo region who want tracking and recovery backed by a national provider's infrastructure.

Jumbo Cash & Carry is a wholesale and retail grocery store stocking bulk food and household goods, the kind of format aimed at both individual households buying in bulk and small businesses restocking shelves. Buying in larger quantities at a cash-and-carry outlet typically works out cheaper per unit than shopping at a standard-sized supermarket.

That dual wholesale-and-retail approach means the store serves two different kinds of customer from the same premises, without needing a separate trade-only entrance or account system. Trading from Nikkel Street in Superbia, the store gives shoppers and small traders across this part of Polokwane a bulk-buying option close to the city's industrial area, rather than driving further out to find the same savings.

Thondoni Lodge and Guesthouse offers air-conditioned, en-suite accommodation aimed at both leisure travellers and business guests passing through Polokwane. A bar on-site gives guests somewhere to unwind in the evening without having to go out, while a swimming pool offers a way to cool off during the warmer months typical of the Limpopo climate.

A braai area is also available, suiting guests who prefer to cook outdoors or host a small gathering rather than eating only at a restaurant. Based on Pafuri Avenue in Penina Park, the lodge serves visitors to this part of Polokwane who want a comfortable, self-contained base with the social spaces that make a longer business or leisure stay feel less like a standard hotel room.

Zanna Motors is an automotive repair workshop servicing and repairing vehicles of all makes and models, rather than limiting its work to a single brand, which suits a mixed-vehicle household or small fleet. General mechanical work, servicing and diagnostics typically fall within the scope of a workshop operating at this scale.

Membership of the Motor Industry Workshop Association, known as MIWA, signals that the workshop operates under the standards and code of conduct that industry body sets for its members. Trading from Pietersburg Street in Annadale, the workshop serves vehicle owners across this part of Polokwane who want servicing and repairs handled by a workshop with recognised industry affiliation rather than an unregistered backyard operator.

Polokwane Provincial Hospital is a public district hospital providing 24-hour emergency care on a walk-in basis, with no appointment required for patients needing urgent treatment. Beyond emergency services, the hospital runs maternity services, chronic medication dispensing, vaccination programmes and general ward care for admitted patients.

Advanced diagnostic imaging is available on-site, including CT and MRI scanning, alongside a dedicated neurology department for patients needing specialist neurological care, a level of service not every district hospital in the region offers. Based at the corner of Dorp Street and Hospital Street in Hospital Park, the hospital serves as a major public healthcare facility for Polokwane and the surrounding Limpopo communities who rely on state healthcare for both emergency and ongoing treatment.

This law firm practises across a broad range of legal work, covering criminal and civil litigation for clients involved in court disputes, as well as commercial law matters for businesses. That spread of practice areas means clients do not necessarily need to find a separate specialist firm for different legal needs.

Matrimonial and maintenance matters are also handled, alongside deceased estate administration for families settling a relative's affairs after death, an area of law many smaller firms avoid taking on. Based in Dada House on Grobler Street in Polokwane, the firm serves clients across the city and wider Limpopo region looking for legal representation spanning both personal and commercial disputes under one roof.

Pizzalitos Ladanna is a pizzeria and takeaway serving a menu built around pizza, burgers, chicken wings and chips, the kind of casual fast-food range aimed at quick, affordable meals rather than a sit-down dining experience. Breakfast items also appear on the menu, extending trade beyond the usual lunch-and-dinner window most takeaways rely on.

Orders can be placed for delivery through the Mr D Food platform, giving customers in Ladanna the option to eat in without collecting the order themselves. Trading from Buluwayo Street, the takeaway serves residents across this part of Polokwane looking for a straightforward meal option covering breakfast through to dinner, without needing to choose between several separate restaurants nearby.

Royal Auto Body is a panel beater and spray painter that has built a specialisation in Mercedes-Benz and Smart vehicle body repairs, a focus that requires familiarity with those brands' specific panel fit and paint finishes. That specialist knowledge sits alongside general auto and commercial body repair work for other makes.

Handling both specialist and general repair work means the workshop can take on a wider range of vehicles than a shop focused on a single brand alone, including commercial vehicles needing bodywork after an accident. Trading from Mangaan Street in Superbia, the business serves vehicle owners across Polokwane needing panel and paint repairs, whether driving a Mercedes-Benz or a more general passenger or commercial vehicle.

Boxer Superstore Turfloop Plaza belongs to the discount supermarket chain known across South Africa for keeping grocery prices low while still running in-store bakery, butchery and hot-food deli counters, rather than selling only pre-packaged stock. That combination gives shoppers fresh options alongside the usual packaged groceries and household goods.

Positioned inside Turfloop Plaza on University Road, the branch sits close to the University of Limpopo, making it a natural grocery stop for students and staff as well as the wider Mankweng community. For budget-conscious shoppers in this part of Polokwane, the discount format and fresh counters together cover most weekly grocery needs without requiring a trip to a pricier mall-based supermarket elsewhere in Limpopo.

Lebowa Funeral Parlour Mankweng provides funeral services covering burial planning and the practical arranging that families need after a death, from paperwork through to the service itself. Event catering is also offered, covering the reception that often follows a funeral, which saves grieving families from having to organise food separately through another supplier.

Operating from premises next to Makanye Mall, the branch serves the Mankweng and wider Sovenga community during a difficult and time-sensitive process, where having planning, arranging and catering available from a single provider can reduce the number of separate arrangements a family needs to make. It gives families in this part of Polokwane, Limpopo, a way to handle funerals close to home rather than further afield.

Master's Guest House is a small, owner-managed guest house offering en-suite rooms fitted with DStv and air-conditioning, the kind of personal-scale accommodation that differs from a larger franchised hotel. Secure parking and Wi-Fi are both included, covering the basics most travellers look for in overnight lodging.

Its location in Zone B, Lebowakgomo, places it conveniently on the route travellers use toward Burgersfort, Jane Furse, Mokopane and Zebediela, making it a practical overnight stop for anyone passing through rather than only a destination in its own right. For travellers crossing this part of Limpopo, it offers a secure, comfortable stopover between towns without needing to continue driving after dark.

Baby City is a national retail chain built entirely around baby and toddler products, and this branch at Mall of the North carries the same wide range found at Baby City stores elsewhere in the country. Stock typically includes baby clothing, nursery furniture, car seats and prams, covering most of what new and expecting parents need to set up a nursery or travel with a young child.

Click and Collect ordering is available, letting parents reserve items online and collect them in person rather than waiting for home delivery. Trading from Shop L11 at the corner of the R81 and N1 in Bendor, the store gives parents across Polokwane a dedicated baby-products option within Limpopo's busiest shopping centre.

Sheet Street Savannah Mall is a branch of the Sheet Street chain, a retailer focused on home textiles such as bedding, curtains and towels rather than general homeware or furniture. That focus lets it stock a deeper range of manchester than a typical department store would carry in the same floor space.

Home decor items round out the range, giving shoppers small finishing touches for a room alongside the core bedding and curtain stock. Trading from Shop 6 inside Savannah Mall, at the corner of Grimm and Thabo Mbeki Streets in Fauna Park, the store serves households across this part of Polokwane looking to refresh bedding or window treatments without a special trip outside Limpopo's provincial capital.
